description: Export scheduled and published posts as formula-safe RFC 4180 CSV ready for Excel or Google Sheets (Studio and Pro). Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

from.description: Optional ISO date or timestamp; only posts at or after this time are included.

locationId.description: Optional location id from locations_list to filter exported posts to one location.

status.description: Filter exported posts by status. Defaults to all non-cancelled posts.

to.description: Optional ISO date or timestamp; only posts at or before this time are included.

name: export_schedule
title: Export schedule CSV
